derived_candidates.text: The M-25 was a licensed version of the Wright R-1820 Cyclone 9, which was widely used on aircraft in the 1930s through 1950s.
The Shvetsov ASh-82 was a Soviet radial engine developed from the M-25, which itself was derived from the Wright R-1820.
